C11287.label: Church–Kleene ordinal
C11287.scope: The least nonrecursive ordinal, equivalently the supremum of the order types of computable well-orderings of the natural numbers.

C11706.label: Kleene algebra
C11706.scope: An idempotent semiring equipped with a star operation satisfying star-unfolding and induction axioms.

C17709.label: Skolem normal form
C17709.scope: A first-order formula with existential quantifiers eliminated using fresh Skolem functions or constants, leaving a universal quantifier prefix, in the usual satisfiability-preserving transformation.

C18045.label: Explicit substitution
C18045.scope: The treatment of substitutions as syntactic constructs with their own rules for propagation or evaluation.

C18772.label: Intuitionistic type theory
C18772.scope: An intuitionistic dependent type theory in which types may depend on terms and propositions admit a types-as-proofs interpretation.

C22977.label: Kleene star
C22977.scope: On a language L, the language of concatenations of finitely many words in L, including the empty concatenation.

C24201.label: Gödel numbering
C24201.scope: An effective encoding of syntactic objects such as formulas and derivations by natural numbers.

C24869.label: Herbrand's theorem
C24869.scope: For an unsatisfiable first-order clause set, there is an unsatisfiable finite set of its ground instances over the Herbrand universe, with a fresh constant available if needed.

C39446.label: Robinson arithmetic
C39446.scope: A finitely axiomatized arithmetic theory in the language of zero, successor, addition and multiplication, with no induction schema.

C4049.label: Structural rule
C4049.scope: A proof rule governing the organization or number of assumptions, for example exchange, weakening, or contraction.

C41499.label: Prenex normal form
C41499.scope: The form of a first-order formula consisting of a quantifier prefix followed by a quantifier-free matrix.

C42139.label: Diagonal lemma
C42139.scope: For a one-variable arithmetical formula, an effective diagonal construction obtains a sentence that an appropriate arithmetic theory proves equivalent to the formula applied to its own Gödel number.

C43008.label: Proof by contradiction
C43008.scope: A proof principle that obtains a proposition by deducing a contradiction from its negation in classical logic.

C43294.label: Rice's theorem
C43294.scope: Every nontrivial extensional property of partial computable functions has an undecidable index set in a standard effective enumeration.

C44107.label: Turing jump
C44107.scope: The relative halting problem for oracle computations in a given set, whose Turing degree strictly exceeds that of the oracle set.

C44728.label: Herbrand interpretation
C44728.scope: A first-order interpretation over the Herbrand universe whose constants and function symbols have their canonical term interpretations.

C44999.label: Church–Rosser theorem
C44999.scope: For beta reduction in the untyped lambda calculus, terms reachable by conversion admit a common beta reduct.

C45880.label: Post's theorem
C45880.scope: The characterization of finite levels of the arithmetical hierarchy in terms of computability and enumerability relative to finite Turing jumps.

C5714.label: Intuitionistic logic
C5714.scope: A logic of constructive proofs in which a proof of arbitrary excluded middle is unavailable.

C7574.label: Kleene's T predicate
C7574.scope: A primitive recursive relation witnessing that a code records a terminating computation for the given program and input.

C8914.label: Kleene–Rosser paradox
C8914.scope: An inconsistency of specific unrestricted systems combining lambda abstraction and strong principles of logic.
